connectionSpecification.description: Reads orders, subscriptions, chargebacks, PayPal disputes, fraud alerts, products and financial entries from one or more Solidgate merchant accounts.

accounts.description: Solidgate merchant accounts to read. Each record carries the name of its account in solid_account.

name.description: Name of the account, unique within this source; written to solid_account.
name.title: Name

public_key.description: API public key of the merchant account (api_pk_...). It is sent in the merchant header.
public_key.title: Public Key

secret_key.description: API secret key of the merchant account (api_sk_...). It signs each request and is never sent.
secret_key.title: Secret Key

accounts.title: Merchant Accounts

lookback_days.description: Days before the last day read that an incremental read requests again, to pick up records that changed late. Default 2.
lookback_days.title: Lookback Days

start_date.description: First UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD, to read. Empty reads the last two years.
start_date.title: Start Date

connectionSpecification.title: Solidgate Source Spec
